summary: Iter19 — Tested the NEW simplified /forecast page (ForecastSimple.jsx) and POST /api/forecast/quick endpoint. Both prompt-only (LLM, claude-sonnet-4-6) and params-only (deterministic) modes work. UI renders verdict banner, 4 KPI cards, 4 charts (PN/CF/Debt+LTV/Ricavi-Utile), year-by-year table, action buttons (variant/compare/pdf) and AI chat. Old /forecast/advanced page still loads with 4 tabs (Editor/Risultati/AI Coach/Confronta).
critical_code_review_comments: ForecastSimple.jsx always sends save:true (line 51) — every Simula click persists a scenario silently. Consider exposing a save toggle in UI or auto-cleaning quick-mode scenarios older than N days; otherwise the user's scenario list will fill up with 'Forecast rapido @ Xy' entries each time they iterate parameters.

forecast.py quick_forecast endpoint duplicates the operation construction loop that already exists in the main scenarios create flow (~lines 1000-1032 vs the AI plan endpoint above). Extracting a normalize_operation(dict) helper would reduce duplication.
Cleanup endpoint pattern: GET /api/forecast/scenarios works but the testing-style 'list with filter' is missing — adding a query param (?quick=true) would simplify future regression cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 16 data-testids found, simulation completed, both pages render)

seed_data_creation: Test temporarily created 1 'Forecast rapido @ 5y' scenario via UI (ForecastSimple always saves) — deleted via DELETE /api/forecast/scenarios/{id}. Other pre-existing scenarios ('Nuovo scenario' x4, 'Crescita controllata 5 anni') left untouched.
